read.en: Bloom Energy fell 7.7% on Nov 16 to $177.28, trading $173.90–183.20. It is below the 5-day ($193.2), 10-day ($191.5), 30-day ($221.6), 100-day ($234.5) and 200-day ($223.7). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 12, below zero, histogram fading toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 ($215.38), and RSI is 40.2.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 11月16日下跌 7.7%，收于 $177.28，盘中区间 $173.90–183.20。股价位于 5 日（$193.2）、10 日（$191.5）、30 日（$221.6）、100 日（$234.5）和 200 日均线（$223.7）下方。MACD 自 11月12日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄、临近下穿；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（$215.38），RSI 为 40.2。

read.en: The drop broke the $183.9–189 support band (Nov 13 low, Nov 10 close, Oct 23 low), now resistance; the $173.90 low tested the Nov 6 close. Resistance is $183.2–185.4, then $189–193.2 (Oct 23 low, 10 and 5-day) and $205.9–209.5. Support is $173.2–173.9, then $167.5–168.8 (Nov 5 close, Nov 6 low) and $156 (Nov 5 low). A close above $185.4 would target $189–193; below $173.2, $167.5–168.8.
